answer.text: Make sure the bike is upright and on its center stand, with the gears in neutral and the neutral lamp glowing in the instrument console.
Switch OFF both the ignition and the engine stop switch, wait a few seconds, then switch both ON again to start the engine.
This resets the roll-over sensor and reactivates the fuel system.

policy.text: After a fall on either side with the engine running and a gear engaged, the roll-over sensor switches the engine OFF to prevent damage to the motorcycle and rider.

watchouts.text: Push and hold the electric start switch until the engine starts, for a maximum of 5 seconds.
If the malfunction indicator does not turn OFF after the engine starts, get the motorcycle checked at a Royal Enfield Authorised Service Centre.
